person.name: Galia Kropach
person.intro: I design interfaces and build them. Ten years of front-end engineering, a background in architecture and visual communication, and a habit of shipping things end to end — from the first Figma frame to the deployed app.

projects.name: Lega11y
projects.description: Scans a site and reports where it falls short of accessibility and legal compliance standards. Built to make the audit automatic instead of a checklist someone works through by hand.

projects.name: CFP Manager
projects.description: A full-stack tool for managing speaking submissions: OAuth sign-in, calendar and mail integrations, and deduplication across sources that list the same call twice.

projects.name: Math Kingdom
projects.description: An educational game that introduces infinity, prime numbers and fractals to kids — concepts usually held back for much later, told through play.

projects.name: First Rule
projects.description: A village with no rules, and the children who have to write them. A game about how democratic processes actually come about. In progress.

projects.name: World Cup Galaxy
projects.tagline: Bilingual World Cup app for kids
projects.description: A free Hebrew and English app following the 2026 World Cup, built for children to navigate on their own.

projects.name: GetOnStage
projects.description: A redesign of the speaker dashboard, built around the gap between a first-time user looking at an empty screen and a returning user with more on their plate than fits.
